senses.gloss: m. (cmp. חסף, a. b. h. חָשַׂף) the curved blade of a double-edged axe, that part which is used for paring or chipping, adze, contrad. to בית בקּיע that part which is used for splitting, v. בִּיקּוּעַ.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 13:3">Kel. XIII, 3</cite> <he>עוֹשְׁפּוֹ</he> (Ar. <he>עָשְׁפּוֹ</he>; R. S. a. l. reads: <he>אָשְׁפּוֹ</he>).

<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 1:3">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. I, 3</cite> <he>קרדום … ועשפו מן הטהור</he> (ed. Zuck. <he>ועשהו</he>, R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 11:4">Kel. XI, 4</cite> <he>ועשאו</he>, corr. acc.) an axe which one made of unclean material, but the adze-shaped part of it is of clean material.
